articles.title: Xona raises $170 million for satellite navigation network
articles.summary:

articles.title: China sends radar mapping and GNSS augmentation sats into orbit with pair of launches
articles.summary:
China conducted a pair of launches in recent days, adding new satellites to the SuperView and CentiSpace low Earth orbit infrastructure constellations.

articles.title: Arctic Winter Sea Ice Ties Record Low, NASA, NSIDC Scientists Find
articles.summary: For the second consecutive year, winter sea ice in the Arctic reached a level that matches the lowest peak observed since satellite monitoring began in 1979. articles.title: NASA’s IXPE Gets Fresh Look at Supernova
articles.summary: NASA’s IXPE (Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer) mission has taken a new observation of a supernova, RCW 86, seen here in an image released on March 24, 2026.
